    n, m = len(a), len(a[0])
    max_palindrome_length = [0] * m
    
    def expand_around_center(s, left, right):
        while left >= 0 and right < len(s) and s[left] == s[right]:
            left -= 1
            right += 1
        return right - left - 1
    
    for j in range(m):
        col_str = ''.join(str(a[i][j]) for i in range(n))
